description: React component for protocol-specific device management operations, including SNMP, WebPA, TR-069, and TR-369 protocols. It provides UI elements to perform GET, SET, WALK, and other operations on devices, with state management for user inputs, results, and errors.

methods.name: executeOperation
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous operation with UI state handling and displays success or error notifications.

methods.name: renderSNMPOperations
methods.description: Renders UI elements for SNMP protocol operations: GET, SET, WALK.

methods.name: renderWebPAOperations
methods.description: Renders UI elements for WebPA protocol operations: GET parameter, SET parameter, GET parameter names.

methods.name: renderTR069Operations
methods.description: Renders UI for TR-069 operations: GET parameters, SET parameters, Reboot.

methods.name: renderTR369Operations
methods.description: Renders UI for TR-369 operations: GET, SET, OPERATE commands.

methods.name: renderOperations
methods.description: Chooses which protocol UI to render based on protocol name.
